field.name: body_html
field.p: Welcome to ! We are very happy to have you as part of our community of wholesale customers.
We want to thank you for choosing us as your supplier of varied products. We are committed to offering you the best quality, variety, and competitive prices to help you boost your business.

a.style: background-color: #875A7B; padding: 8px 16px 8px 16px; text-decoration: none; color: #fff; border-radius: 5px; font-size:13px;

field.p:
Here are a few things you can do to start making the most of your
account:

ul.li: Explore our catalog: Discover our wide selection of imported and domestic fruits, from the classics to the most exotic.
Check out our wholesale prices: Access exclusive rates for registered customers and take advantage of our special promotions.
Place your first order: Enjoy an easy and secure purchasing process, with flexible delivery options to suit your needs.
Contact our support team: If you have any questions or need help, please don't hesitate to contact us. We are here to support you every step of the way.

field.p: As a new customer, we offer you a [Optional: Include a discount, special offer, or additional benefit for new customers]. Use the code [Discount/Offer Code] when placing your first order.

We look forward to building a long-lasting and successful relationship with you. Thank you for joining the
family!
